proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9503 *bhiyañjati wets/is wetted explicitly gives Bhojpuri bhī̃jal and Gujarati bhĩjāvũ/bhĩjavvũ. Nasal binj/bhinj wet responses match this nasal branch, with aspiration loss, y/ai and l-participial endings qualified. They are not collapsed into the nonnasal 9502 stem; the local transmission route remains open. Exact response: bhinjailo.
